item.title: Prairie Band Potawatomi intends to ditch $30M ICE contract, chairman announces
item.description: The Prairie Band Potawatomi Tribe’s chairman compared immigrant detention to Indian reservations in an online video address Friday, and declared the tribe’s intention to jettison a recently secured contract to design detention centers. Continue reading ...

item.title: Johnson County officers kill a stabbing suspect at Panasonic plant. Here’s what we know
item.description: The Panasonic plant in De Soto shut down after officers shot a person suspected of stabbing another. The suspect is dead, and the stabbing victim was transported to the hospital in critical condition. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence advisory boards will reevaluate city’s goal to achieve fully renewable energy usage
item.description: Members of two Lawrence advisory boards will soon put their heads together to evaluate whether the city’s renewable energy goals are realistic, and how they line up with overarching sustainability plans for the county. Continue reading ...

item.title: Community-building on display at Winter Inclusive Market in Lawrence
item.description: Jesse and Linda Hunter carry a legacy of their family's barbecue business through their homemade sauces. Jesse & Linny's BBQ Sauce was one of around 100 vendors at the Winter Inclusive Market, which reopens Sunday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Champions of Lawrence arts celebrated at 25th Phoenix Awards
item.description: More supportive spaces for Native American youth to grow in the arts and entrepreneurship are always needed, said Rachael Lackey, one of six Phoenix Award recipients recognized Sunday for their contributions to Lawrence arts. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kaw Valley Almanac for Dec. 15-21, 2025
item.description: This time of year is a great time to lie down in some tallgrass prairie remnant on a sunny day, and it will shield you from the wind and insulate you from the cold ground. See what you see in the deep, blue winter solstice sky. Continue reading ...

item.title: Deerfield Elementary teacher earns Dedication to Education award
item.description: Melissa Clover, a fourth grade teacher at Deerfield Elementary School, was surprised Monday with an award for her dedication to student success. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners to discuss rec center access fees; vice mayor proposes new plan
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will revisit the access fees the city is planning to charge people to use rec centers. A new commissioner has a proposal to patch a budget deficit that staff members say would result without fee revenue. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County Commission to consider a limited tenant right to counsel pilot program
item.description: The Douglas County Commission on Wednesday will review staff recommendations to create a limited tenant right to counsel pilot program for 2027, despite an advocacy group’s calls for a program to support all renters facing eviction. Continue reading ...
